'''H3-4RT''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] operating during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="CWA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|A perfect companion for any Cupid clone, this little astromech fills your heart with love!|Store description of H3-4RT|<ref name="CWA" />}}
H3-4RT featured in the online game [[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']], as a limited edition item that could be purchased for Valentines Day [[2011]].
